name: build-label-proto
description: Build label prototype: the Firmware screen (Setup Menu, Firmware) shows 'Body : 1.6  EPM2Mod 2026.11.19'. The version number is not changed (block 0 header +16 = 0x1600, prm tag 0xC082). Four byte edits, no new code: the panel's object grows so that its value text holds 48 characters, the Body line formats with its own text in a wider box, and that text in unreferenced debug strings of segment 2. See experiments/2026-11-19-build-label/NOTES.md.

ops._note: panel 99 (Firmware screen) object: 936 -> 1024 bytes; its last field (+928) is the value text, which grows from 4 to 48 UTF-16 characters
panel 99, line 0 (Body): the format text 0x7EBB2FEC instead of the shared L"%X.%X"
panel 99, widget 10 (the Body value), both copies of its rectangle: x 369 w 100 -> x 331 w 341 (640-wide coordinates; the text is centred in it)
the Body line's format text L"%X.%X  EPM2Mod 2026.11.19", in unreferenced Bluetooth debug strings (reclaim-space row 2)
